mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( score, comment, reservation_id ) VALUES ( #{score}, #{comment}, #{reservationId} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.score, r.comment, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN reservations rs ON r.reservation_id = rs.id WHERE rs.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT r.id, r.score, r.comment, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN reservations rs ON r.reservation_id = rs.id WHERE rs.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
